title: Changing the lead on Board or Tech View asks whether to clear shifts
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A work order led by technician A that has a whole-work-order scheduled shift for A AND a line-level shift; in Board/Tech View.
custom_steps:
1. Change the lead from A to B in Board or Tech View.
  2. Confirm you are asked whether to clear A's whole-work-order shifts.
  3. Choose Clear on one run: confirm only A's whole-work-order shifts are removed and the line-level shift remains.
  4. Repeat on another work order and choose Keep: confirm the lead changes and A's shifts remain.
  5. In both runs confirm the line-level shift was never cleared.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Changing the lead in Board View or Tech View asks whether to clear the outgoing lead's whole-work-order scheduled shifts.
  • Choosing to clear shifts removes only the outgoing lead's shifts scheduled against the whole work order.
  • Choosing to keep shifts changes the lead and leaves the existing shifts in place.
  • This prompt never clears shifts scheduled against individual work-order lines.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Story 4 Reassign or unassign the lead technician. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S4-R11, S4-R22, S4-R23, S4-R24 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R11: “When changing the lead technician in Board View or Tech View, ask whether to clear the outgoing lead’s work-order-level scheduled shifts.”
  • S4-R22: “If the user chooses to clear shifts, remove only the outgoing lead’s shifts scheduled against that whole work order.”
  • S4-R23: “If the user chooses to keep shifts, change the lead technician and retain the existing shifts.”
  • S4-R24: “Never clear shifts scheduled against individual work order lines through this prompt.”
